login.title: Sign in to Navo
login.subtitle: Track contracts, purchase orders and deliveries.
login.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

overview.introClear: Nothing needs attention. Everything is on track.
overview.noUpcoming: No deliveries planned in the next 7 days.
overview.adminIntro: The Admin role does not include business reports or receivables.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.searchPlaceholder: Contract no., title, customer, customer ref…
contracts.emptyHint: Create the first contract to start tracking.
contracts.noLinesHint: Good — every line is on track.

contract.activateHint: The contract gets its official number (SC-year signed-sequence) and can be used for purchase orders and deliveries.
contract.draftBanner: Draft contract — not counted in figures yet. Activate it once the customer has signed.
contract.legend: Progress bar: dark blue is delivered, light blue is received but not yet delivered. Click a line for details.

next.no_plan: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: {{remaining}} {{unit}} have no delivery plan ({{available}} available now).
next.stock_short: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: the {{date}} delivery needs {{needed}}, only {{available}} {{unit}} available.
next.receipt_overdue: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: goods are late against the expected date. Check with the supplier.
next.under_ordered: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: {{missing}} {{unit}} not yet ordered from a supplier.
next.over_ordered: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: ordered {{over}} {{unit}} more than the contract.
next.over_delivered: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: delivered {{over}} {{unit}} more than the contract.

docs.unitPriceHidden: Purchase prices are shown only to people allowed to see them.

po.title: New purchase order from contract
po.pickHint: Quantities still to order are filled in.
po.etaHint: Enter it so Navo can flag late goods.
po.overWarning: {{over}} {{unit}} over the contract. You can save a draft; confirming needs Admin approval.
po.after: Once confirmed, the lines' ordered quantities increase and the PO can no longer be edited directly.

gr.title: Record goods received · {{number}}
gr.hint: Only accepted goods count as received; rejected goods are tracked separately.

do.consequence: Once confirmed, line {{line}} delivered goes up by {{qty}} {{unit}}. It cannot be edited directly; corrections need a reversal with a reason.

newContract.title: New contract
newContract.subtitle: Saved as a draft; activate it once the customer has signed.
newContract.nameHint: Leave empty to use the catalogue name.
newContract.noCustomers: No customers yet. Add a customer first.

partners.title: Customers & suppliers
partners.codeHint: 2–12 capital letters or digits, e.g. STRA.
partners.name: Name

users.title: Users & permissions
users.name: Full name
users.passwordHint: 10–72 characters. The user should change it after first sign-in.
users.adminNote: Administrators have all permissions and can view all company records.
users.resetHint: Set a temporary password, tell the person directly, and remind them to change it after signing in. All their current sessions end.
users.resetDone: Password reset for {{name}}. Tell them the temporary password.
users.deactivateHint: Untick when someone leaves: they are signed out at once and the data they created stays.
users.selfHint: You cannot deactivate yourself or remove your own Admin role.
users.rolesHint: A person can hold several roles. Roles decide the menu and the data they see.
users.scopeHint: Whose customers, contracts and orders this person sees (from their roles).
users.grantsHint: Additional permissions supplement the selected roles. Permissions included in a role remain enabled.
users.grantNotYours: Only someone who holds this permission can give it to others.

grantDesc.purchase_cost_read: Sees supplier unit prices on purchase orders and exports.
grantDesc.finance_read: Sees receivables, payables, money received and unallocated.
grantDesc.fulfillment_confirm: Moves receipts and deliveries from draft to confirmed (counted in figures).
grantDesc.quantity_override: Approves ordering or delivering over the contract. Sees quantities and reasons, never purchase prices.

users.unsaved: Unsaved changes. The person sees the new menu the next time a page loads.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

network.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
network.timeout: The server took too long. Please try again.

codes.auth_unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
codes.auth_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
codes.resource_not_found: Not found, or you do not have access.
codes.resource_conflict: Someone else just changed this. Reload and try again.
codes.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.

reasons.contract_not_draft: Only a draft contract can be activated.
reasons.contract_not_active: This contract is not active. Activate or reopen it before ordering, receiving, delivering or correcting.
reasons.quantity_exceeds_contract: Line {{line_no}}: over the contract (contract {{contract_quantity}}, ordered {{already_ordered}}, adding {{requested}}). The PO stays a draft; Admin approval is needed.
reasons.receipt_exceeds_ordered: Line {{line_no}}: accepted goods exceed the quantity ordered (ordered {{ordered}}, already received {{already_received}}).
reasons.insufficient_stock: Line {{line_no}}: not enough goods (available {{available}}, needed {{requested}}). Record goods received first.
reasons.purchase_order_not_confirmed: Confirm the purchase order before recording goods.
reasons.idempotency_payload_mismatch: This action was already sent with different details. Close and reopen to refresh.
reasons.assign_owner: You can only create contracts for yourself.
reasons.idempotency_authorization_changed: Your permissions or assignments changed. Reload the document to check the saved outcome.
reasons.version_conflict: This record changed. Reload it before saving your changes.
reasons.reversal_has_dependents: Correct the dependent documents or allocations first.
reasons.document_not_confirmed: Only confirmed documents can be reversed.
reasons.document_not_posted: Only posted cash documents can be reversed.
reasons.invoice_has_payments: Reverse the linked payment allocations before cancelling this invoice.
reasons.acceptance_requires_delivery: Acceptance requires full delivery on or before the acceptance date.
reasons.milestone_already_triggered: An event is already recorded. Correct it before entering a new event.
reasons.nothing_to_close: There is no outstanding quantity to cancel.
reasons.legacy_export_unavailable: This older batch has no frozen file. Use the originally downloaded workbook.
reasons.export_amount_precision: An amount is too large for a reliable Excel currency export.
reasons.archive_too_large: This archive exceeds 500 MB. Download individual documents.
reasons.ai_daily_limit: You reached your daily document-reading limit.
reasons.files.write: You do not have permission to change document files.
reasons.invalid_mfa_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Try the next code.
reasons.mfa_enrollment_required: Turn on two-step sign-in on the web first.
reasons.override_already_pending: This document is already waiting for Admin.
reasons.override_already_decided: This request has already been decided.
reasons.cannot_lock_out_self: You cannot deactivate yourself or remove your own Admin role.
reasons.has_draft_receipts: Cancel this order's draft goods receipts first.
reasons.email_disabled: Email is not set up for this installation yet.
reasons.override_self_decision: Another approver must decide your own request.
reasons.not_customer_owner: Only this customer's owner, owners of its open contracts and admin can change or email its contacts.
reasons.owner_change: Only an administrator can choose a customer's owner.
reasons.acceptance_from_documents: Acceptance is recorded as a document on the contract; this term falls due when every line is fully accepted.
reasons.acceptance_has_payments: Money is allocated to a term that falls due on acceptance. Reverse those allocations first.
reasons.contract_not_delivered: Every line must be fully delivered before closing. Amend a quantity down, or cancel instead.
reasons.contract_cancel_blocked: This contract has deliveries, open orders, collected money or invoices. Correct those first.
reasons.contract_has_drafts: Confirm or cancel the draft orders, receipts and deliveries first.
reasons.contract_not_closed: Only a closed or cancelled contract can be reopened.
reasons.amendment_affects_paid_term: Money was collected on full delivery. Put extra goods on a new contract, or reverse that allocation first.
reasons.mfa_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
reasons.mfa_required_for_admin: Administrators must keep two-step sign-in on.
reasons.mfa_reset_self: Another administrator must reset your two-step sign-in.
reasons.import_header_missing: The file has no header row with the required columns. Start from the template.
reasons.import_file_changed: The file is not the one you previewed. Preview it again.
reasons.quotation_closed: This quotation is already won or lost.
reasons.quotation_status: This quotation cannot change that way from its current status.
reasons.quotation_was_sent: A quotation the customer has seen is kept. Mark it as lost instead.
reasons.zalo_unreachable: Cannot reach Zalo right now. Try again in a moment.
reasons.zalo_send_failed: Zalo did not accept the message.
reasons.misa_preview_changed: Matches changed. Preview the file again before confirming.
reasons.terms_mismatch: Payment milestones ({{terms}}) must add up to the contract value incl. VAT ({{total}}) before activation.
reasons.milestone_invoiced: An invoice was issued for this milestone. Cancel the invoice before changing it.
reasons.override_exists: This delivery has an over-quantity request. Cancel it and plan again to change the quantities.
reasons.ai_busy: The reading service is busy. Try again in a minute.
reasons.ai_disabled: AI drafts are not turned on for this installation.
reasons.ai_file_unreadable: This file could not be read (too large or not supported).
reasons.ai_refused: This file could not be read automatically. Please enter it by hand.
reasons.ai_timeout: Reading took too long. Try a shorter file or fewer pages.
reasons.ai_too_long: The document is too long to read at once. Split it and try again.
reasons.ai_unavailable: Reading is not available right now. Fill it in yourself.
reasons.allocation_exceeds_receipt: The amounts are more than what is left on this payment.
reasons.contract_not_open: Payment terms can be changed only on draft or active contracts.
reasons.draft_has_dependents: This draft already has notes or evidence. Resolve them first.
reasons.idempotency_in_progress: The same request is still being processed. Wait a moment.
reasons.idempotency_key_reused: This was already sent with different content. Close and start again.
reasons.import_empty: The file has no item rows under the header.
reasons.lead_won: This lead is already a customer.
reasons.milestone_automatic: This milestone starts by itself (signing, full delivery or a fixed date).
reasons.milestone_in_use: Money or an invoice is linked to this milestone.
reasons.misa_file_unknown: This file does not look like a MISA customer, supplier or product list.
reasons.not_service_contract: Service visits belong to maintenance & repair contracts.
reasons.nothing_to_export: No document is ready to export for this period.
reasons.nothing_to_schedule: Every visit of this line is already done or planned.
reasons.visit_not_planned: Only a visit not done yet can be changed.
reasons.tax_lookup_off: Looking up tax codes is turned off.
reasons.tax_code_not_found: No company is registered with tax code {{tax_code}}.
reasons.tax_lookup_unavailable: The tax code register cannot be reached right now. Fill in the details by hand.
reasons.purchase_order_open: Goods are still on order. Close the outstanding purchase-order quantities first.
reasons.amendment_empties_contract: An amendment cannot set every line to zero. Cancel the contract instead.
reasons.before_cutover: This date is on or before the opening cut-over, so it is already in the opening balances. Use a later date.
reasons.opening_debt: This is an old invoice from the opening balances, not a working contract.
reasons.purchase_order_not_open: This purchase order is no longer waiting for goods.
reasons.approval_required: This change needs approval from a sales manager or admin.
reasons.change_already_pending: A request of this kind is already waiting for approval.
reasons.change_self_decision: Another sales manager or admin must decide your own request.
reasons.change_already_decided: This request has already been decided.
reasons.quotation_in_contract: A draft contract was made from this quotation. Change or delete the draft first.
reasons.quotation_expired: This quotation is past its validity date. Change the date before sending it.
reasons.lead_lost: This lead was marked lost. Reopen it before quoting.
reasons.opening_document: This document is part of the opening balances reconciled with MISA. Correct it in MISA instead.
reasons.acceptance_invoiced: An invoice was issued for a term due on acceptance. Cancel it first.
reasons.amendment_below_invoiced: The contract would be worth less than what was already invoiced.
reasons.delivered_before_received: On that date not enough goods had been received. Check the delivery and receipt dates.
reasons.confirmed_line_immutable: A confirmed document's lines do not change; correct it with a reversal.
reasons.change_not_applied: The change could not be applied.
reasons.invite_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask your administrator for a new one.

validation.decimal: Enter a number with at most {{max_scale}} decimals.
validation.one_of: Please choose a value from the list.
validation.taken: This value is already in use.
validation.not_in_contract: This line is not part of the contract.
validation.not_customer: This partner is not a customer.
validation.not_supplier: This partner is not a supplier.
validation.tax_code: A tax code has 10 digits (or 10 digits-3 digits).
validation.required_when_firm: Choose a date when the plan is firm.
validation.in_use: In use on documents, so it cannot be removed.
validation.same_as_current: The new password must differ from the current one.
validation.not_emailable: None of the chosen people can receive email (no address, or they asked to stop).
validation.not_future: This date cannot be in the future.
validation.before_signing: This date is before the contract was signed ({{signed_on}}).
validation.below_delivered: Cannot be below {{min}} (already delivered or accepted).
validation.invalid_mfa_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Try the next code.
validation.zalo_token_rejected: Zalo does not accept this token. Copy it again from the message Zalo sent you.
validation.service_unavailable: Service contracts are not available yet.
validation.exceeds_unplanned: Only {{max}} is still unplanned. Change an existing plan first.
validation.terms_exceed_value: Milestones would exceed the contract value incl. VAT ({{total}}). At most {{max}} is left.
validation.not_collectable: Not due yet, so no money can go to it.
validation.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{max_mb}} MB.
validation.file_type: This file type is not allowed.
validation.after_start: Must be after the start date.
validation.edit_contacts_separately: Edit contacts in the contacts list.
validation.edit_terms_separately: Edit payment milestones on the contract page.
validation.service_line: Service lines are done by service visits, not deliveries.
validation.paid_term_trigger: Money was already collected on this term ({{paid}}). Reverse those allocations before changing what makes it due.
validation.exceeds_term: More than the term leaves to invoice ({{left}}).
validation.before_issued: Cannot be before the issue date.
validation.acceptance_only: Only an acceptance can carry a penalty.
validation.whole_number: Enter a whole number of visits.

mobile.offline: No connection. Showing figures from {{time}}; they may be out of date.
mobile.offlineNoData: No connection. Pull down to retry when online.
mobile.poMeaning: A purchase order is sent to a supplier.
mobile.doMeaning: A delivery is one shipment to the customer.
mobile.webOnly: Creating and confirming documents is done on the web.

attn.receipt_overdue: Goods have not arrived by the expected date.

mobile.noTasks: Nothing to do. Follow-ups from your notes show here.
mobile.noArriving: No goods due in the next 7 days.

orders.title: Orders and deliveries
orders.noneAwaiting: No purchase order is waiting for goods.

mobile.twoStepRequired: Your account must turn on two-step sign-in before using Navo. Set it up on the web (Account → Two-step sign-in), then sign in here again.
mobile.mustChange: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose your own before you continue.

note.title: Customer meeting note
note.bodyPlaceholder: What the customer said, needs, promised…
note.voiceHint: Tap "Speak", then the microphone on the keyboard. Say something like "Huy needs a quote for 6 DN80 valves before 20/11, remind me Friday".
note.needTask: Enter what to do for the reminder date.

saved.title: Saved on this phone
saved.text: The note is on the phone and not sent yet.

offline.title: No connection — saved on this phone
offline.text: Navo sends it when you are online. You can close this screen.

sent.title: Sent
sent.text: The note and next step are in Navo.

recovery.attachmentPending: The draft and payment terms are saved. Retry to attach the source file.
recovery.finishPending: Finish the pending receipt before changing its contents.
recovery.handoverHint: Select the contracts and open tasks to transfer. Historical authors remain unchanged.

service.title: Service visits
service.mineHint: Visits assigned to you. Open one to see where to go and record it when done.
service.allHint: Every planned maintenance and repair visit.

account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
